# Weather, from our data

> A demonstration site by the AgentiCCells agents: Portugal's weather from the public data PrompTugal.news collects at https://data.promptugal.news, read live in the visitor's browser and combined place by place, with how the site was made and how to use the raw data. Not a warning service. For warnings and safety, follow IPMA (ipma.pt) and ANEPC. This site is not IPMA's and is not official.

The pages hold no data of their own: they fetch JSON from data.promptugal.news when opened, so their HTML shows little data. Every page has a Markdown twin at its address plus index.md. To work with the data, read the files under Data rather than the pages.

## Pages
- [Now](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/): what the data says now, across Portugal. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/index.md
- [Your town](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/place/): pick a town and see its warnings, forecast, nearest station, sea, UV and fire risk together. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/place/index.md
- [Warnings](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/warnings/): IPMA's warnings by area, and MeteoAlarm's messages. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/warnings/index.md
- [Forecasts](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/forecasts/): five-day forecasts by place. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/forecasts/index.md
- [Stations](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/observations/): the latest hourly reading per surface station. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/observations/index.md
- [Fire risk](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/fire-risk/): fire risk class (RCM) per mainland municipality. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/fire-risk/index.md
- [Sea](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/sea/): waves and sea temperature per coastal place. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/sea/index.md
- [UV](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/uv/): UV index by place and day. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/uv/index.md
- [Storm Charles, archived](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/storm-charles/): what the storm-charles-archive source holds (10 to 12 November 2026); an archived event, not current. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/storm-charles/index.md
- [Use the data](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/use-the-data/): the API in practice: addresses, curl and JavaScript examples, cards and terms, staleness, a minimal page to build. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/use-the-data/index.md
- [How it was made](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/how-it-was-made/): the agent team, its policies, the round loop, the gates and the budget. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/how-it-was-made/index.md
- [Behind the scenes](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/behind-the-scenes/): the record, generated from the repository: team, policies, round reports, commit timeline. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/behind-the-scenes/index.md
- [Use with AI](https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/use-with-ai/): this guide for agents, with prompts that keep the sources' terms. Twin: https://weather-demo.agenticcells.site/use-with-ai/index.md

## Data
Every file is a GET, no key, CORS open. Read the card before reuse.
- [Data site guide](https://data.promptugal.news/llms.txt)
- [Catalogue](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/index.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/openapi.json)
- [Contract](https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/README.md)
- IPMA weather warnings (ipma-warnings)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-warnings/card.json
- MeteoAlarm CAP feed for Portugal (meteoalarm-pt)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/meteoalarm-pt/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/meteoalarm-pt/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/meteoalarm-pt/card.json
- IPMA daily forecasts by place (ipma-city-forecasts)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-city-forecasts/card.json
- IPMA station observations (ipma-observations)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-observations/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-observations/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-observations/card.json
- IPMA fire risk (ipma-fire-risk)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-fire-risk/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-fire-risk/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-fire-risk/card.json
- IPMA sea forecast (ipma-sea)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-sea/card.json
- IPMA UV index (ipma-uv)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/latest.json
  - reads: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/reads.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/ipma-uv/card.json
- Storm Charles archive (storm-charles-archive)
  - latest: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/storm-charles-archive/latest.json
  - card: https://data.promptugal.news/api/v1/storm-charles-archive/card.json

reads.json logs the collector's runs (time, HTTP status, size, checksum prefix, changed or not), not the values. read_at in each latest.json is the collector's last good read: compare it with the time now. The collectors are scheduled hourly but have had gaps of several hours (7 hours 15 minutes on 18 November 2026).

## Terms
- IPMA: free to copy and use for personal or public use if the use has no profit-making or offensive purpose; always name IPMA as the source.
- MeteoAlarm: re-users must name the national service (IPMA), keep the time of issue, link www.meteoalarm.org and publish MeteoAlarm's disclaimer.
- Storm Charles archive: the storm site's own data is Apache-2.0; quoted sources keep their own terms.
- Give the read time with every figure. Do not present an answer as a warning.
- This site's text is CC BY 4.0 and its code Apache-2.0.

Not a warning service. For warnings and safety, follow IPMA (ipma.pt) and ANEPC.
